name: io.github.AutumLabs/authoryx
title: Authoryx
description: Ask to use a secret shared with your agent; its owner approves; no tool returns the value.

environmentVariables.name: AUTHORYX_AGENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: The agent's id, agt_…; leave unset to use authoryx login

environmentVariables.name: AUTHORYX_AGENT_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The agent's key, axa_…; leave unset to use the OS keychain
